name: etsy-automation
description: Daily Etsy digital product automation skill

notes.puppeteer-core: Used by svg-designer.js to render SVG → PNG/PDF via the system Chrome/Chromium. Run `npm install` before first use.
notes.chrome: svg-designer.js requires Chrome or Chromium. The sandbox container has it at /usr/bin/google-chrome or /usr/bin/chromium-browser. Install if missing: apt-get install -y chromium-browser
notes.canva: canva-designer.js (Canva Connect API) is no longer used by default. svg-designer.js generates designs directly via Claude. canva-designer.js is still available for manual use.
notes.etsy: The Etsy API v3 is a REST API — no npm package needed. Authenticate via OAuth 2.0 at https://<your-worker>/etsy/auth after deploying.
notes.claude: Uses the Anthropic REST API directly via fetch(). Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
